name: pro-egm
description: Glue for Google's Elephant-Goldfish Model (egm@egm), one command per EGM skill: /pro-egm:brainstorm (discovery interview, options research with dated sources, goldfish swarm and an architect, security and sponsor brief review, before any intent), /pro-egm:draft, /pro-egm:review (staged review, stages 5 to 9), /pro-egm:resolve, /pro-egm:bootstrap (README contracts), /pro-egm:drift (design against code, report only), /pro-egm:lite and /pro-egm:goldfish (review loop on a spec, plan or brief with reviewers a repo keeps in .egm/). Each reads the installed engine's SKILL.md and follows it. Needs egm@egm, installed by /pro-core:pro-dev install. Codex users use the bridge's install lines and EGM's skill picker instead of the slash commands.
